title: Image
description: Displays an image with responsive behavior, showing different images on mobile and desktop if needed. Images automatically optimize for performance.

alt_text.title: Alt Text
alt_text.description: Text description of the image for accessibility and SEO.

image_desktop.title: Image - Desktop
image_desktop.description: Image displayed on desktop and tablet. Used on mobile if no mobile image is provided.

image_mobile.title: Image - Mobile
image_mobile.description: Image displayed on mobile devices. If not provided, desktop image is used.

aspect_ratio_desktop.title: Aspect Ratio - Desktop
aspect_ratio_desktop.description: Image proportions on desktop. Defaults to Original.

aspect_ratio_mobile.title: Aspect Ratio - Mobile
aspect_ratio_mobile.description: Image proportions on mobile. Defaults to Original.
